steps.prompt: Target: the Nebius x NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon (https://nebiusglobalaihackathon.devpost.com/, deadline "October 30, 2026 @ 10:00am PDT"). Using WebFetch only, read the overview, rules, judging and prizes pages, the Nebius Token Factory docs (OpenAI-compatible API, NVIDIA Nemotron models, pricing) and the Tavily search API docs. Write research.md: deliverables, judging criteria, the 'significantly updated' rule for existing projects, which prizes are cash and remote (City Winner awards need attendance: exclude them), the Most Valuable Feedback prize requirements, and per-token prices. Reply with a 5-line summary.

steps.verify: test -f package.json && npm install --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1; npm test

steps.cmd: npm test && grep -q MAX_USD src/budget.ts && test -s FEEDBACK.md

steps.prompt: Write SUBMISSION.md for Devpost: name, tagline, story sections, built-with tags, which prize categories to select (only cash, remote ones), a 'Video script' for a 3-minute demo, and a 'Human checklist' (Nebius account with a spend cap, record the video, submit as the MB's representative, W-8BEN and affidavit if winning). Do not submit anything.
steps.verify: test -s SUBMISSION.md && grep -q 'Video script' SUBMISSION.md && grep -q 'Human checklist' SUBMISSION.md
